investigation.title: Remote Agents: Swarm Gateway 502 Causing Total Eval Failure Across All Remote-Agent Checks
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-02T01:03:13Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm provisioning gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 targeted at /v1/agents — was unreachable. Because the failure occurs at the very first HTTP call (POST /api/agents), no evidence was collected and all required contract fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) are missing.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting the /v1/agents provisioning endpoint) was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production-api layer returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning" on every attempt. Because all three sibling checks share the same upstream dependency — POST /api/agents → swarm ELB → /v1/agents — and all three returned the identical error message within the same ~33-second window, the failure is localized to that shared upstream dependency rather than to any individual check's logic or eval runner code. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence; this is an eval-layer failure against the production-api runtime environment.
